about: WP-38: the tools the relay's MCP server offers. The relay lists them (tools/list) and forwards calls to the IDE page, which runs them (web/agent/tools.ts). Projects live in the browser, persisted in OPFS; paths are relative to the project.

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create a Cargo project in the browser IDE. Without files it is `cargo new`: Cargo.toml (edition 2021) and src/main.rs. With files, exactly those (relative path -> content). Fails if the project exists, unless overwrite is true.

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List the projects in the browser IDE.

tools.name: project_delete
tools.description: Delete a project and its files.

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List a project's files (relative paths), without target/ and hidden directories.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a file of a project.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Write (create or replace) a file of a project; directories are created as needed.

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description: Delete a file of a project.

tools.name: dependency_add
tools.description: Add (or change) a dependency in a Cargo.toml, like `cargo add`, and resolve against crates.io. Returns the lockfile changes, or the resolver's error with nothing changed.

version.description: Version requirement, e.g. "1" or "1.0.200"; default: the newest.

dir.description: The package's directory in a workspace (default: the project root).

tools.name: dependency_remove
tools.description: Remove a dependency from a Cargo.toml and resolve again.

tools.name: cargo_check
tools.description: `cargo check`: type-check the project (dependencies are fetched from crates.io and cached). Returns ok and rustc's diagnostics (level, message, code, file, line, rendered).

tools.name: cargo_build
tools.description: `cargo build` (dev profile, target wasm32-wasip1). Returns ok, diagnostics, the executables and per-unit timings.

tools.name: cargo_run
tools.description: `cargo run`: build, then run the program in the sandbox (WASI, no network, only the project's files readable). Returns the build diagnostics, then exit code, stdout and stderr.

bin.description: Which executable, if there are several.

tools.name: cargo_test
tools.description: `cargo test`: build the test harnesses and run every test in its own process. Returns per-test results (suite, name, status ok/failed/ignored, ms, stdout, panic message) and counts. `filter` selects tests by substring (or the exact name with `exact`).

tools.name: cargo_clippy
tools.description: `cargo clippy`: Clippy's lints on the project's own packages. Returns ok and the diagnostics (codes like clippy::needless_return).

tools.name: cargo_fmt
tools.description: `cargo fmt`: rustfmt on every .rs file of the project (rustfmt.toml respected). With check, nothing changes: returns which files aren't formatted, with diffs.
